description: Release fixtures: each directory is a release, its manifest.json beside its archives. Verified with the manifest's schema, and as an approved release when approved is true, each must give the findings listed, by code, path and field; for an archive refused as unsafe, cause is the IO code its message starts with. A fixture with no finding is accepted.

fixtures.name: accepted
fixtures.description: An approved release of two scenarios sharing one payload, one with attachments.

fixtures.name: archive-sha256
fixtures.description: An archive whose SHA-256 is not the one the manifest lists.

fixtures.name: archive-size
fixtures.description: An archive whose size is not the one the manifest lists.

fixtures.name: archive-missing
fixtures.description: An archive the manifest lists, missing.

fixtures.name: file-not-listed
fixtures.description: A file beside the archives that the manifest does not list.

fixtures.name: path-traversal
fixtures.description: An archive whose scenario entry leaves the extraction directory.

fixtures.name: decompression-bomb
fixtures.description: An archive under 1 MiB whose scenario entry is over 100 MiB once inflated.

fixtures.name: decompression-bomb-undeclared
fixtures.description: An archive whose scenario entry inflates beyond the size it declares.

fixtures.name: too-many-entries
fixtures.description: An archive of more than 1,000 entries.

fixtures.name: entry-link
fixtures.description: An archive whose attachments entry is a symbolic link.

fixtures.name: entry-twice
fixtures.description: An archive holding two entries of one name.

fixtures.name: entry-not-built
fixtures.description: An archive holding an entry build never writes.

fixtures.name: attachments-password
fixtures.description: Attachments encrypted with another password than the shared one.

fixtures.name: scenario-part
fixtures.description: A scenario with a part outside the closed list of a stored scenario.

fixtures.name: payload-content
fixtures.description: A payload whose content is not the one the hash listed for its ID describes.

fixtures.name: payload-not-listed
fixtures.description: A payload embedded in an archive that the manifest does not list.

fixtures.name: payload-not-embedded
fixtures.description: A payload the manifest lists that the archive does not embed.

fixtures.name: payload-without-id
fixtures.description: A payload embedded without its ID, which no manifest can list.

fixtures.name: payload-unhashable
fixtures.description: A payload whose canonical hash cannot be computed.

fixtures.name: payload-listed-twice
fixtures.description: A payload an item lists twice.

fixtures.name: payload-outside-contract
fixtures.description: A payload outside an inject's contract, which no reference names.

fixtures.name: payload-two-contents
fixtures.description: One payload ID listed with two contents by two scenarios of the release.

fixtures.name: chaining-accepted
fixtures.description: A release of a scenario in chaining, two steps one after the other, sharing its payload with a time-based scenario.

fixtures.name: chaining-payload-not-listed
fixtures.description: A scenario in chaining whose steps embed a payload the manifest does not list.

fixtures.name: chaining-payload-content
fixtures.description: A step whose payload is not the one the hash listed for its ID describes.

fixtures.name: chaining-payload-outside-contract
fixtures.description: A step that carries a payload outside its contract, which no reference names.

fixtures.name: chaining-workflow-shape
fixtures.description: A scenario in chaining whose steps are not a list.

fixtures.name: chaining-step-data-text
fixtures.description: A scenario in chaining whose steps keep their data as text, as an export writes it, which would hide their payloads from a reader of objects.

fixtures.name: chaining-scenario-part
fixtures.description: A scenario in chaining that also holds a part outside the closed list of a stored scenario: the workflow does not open the list.

fixtures.name: manifest-schema
fixtures.description: A manifest that does not meet its schema: an unknown channel.

fixtures.name: approver-missing
fixtures.description: A release verified as approved whose manifest names no release approver.

fixtures.name: scenario-twice
fixtures.description: A manifest listing one scenario twice.

fixtures.name: archive-name
fixtures.description: An archive named after another version than its item's.
